meta.description: Q-allocation: (a) base-model allocation set by attachments and fusion scale; (b) plastic attachments under the energy rule; (c1-c3) the added similarity-matching principle: mass law, specialisation under ingredients, deviation from the law.

a.attach: block: 3 inputs inside one block, Dirichlet shares, deg 1
a.variance_sweep: block 0 variance in (.25..8), others 1, 12 neurons per block
a.count_sweep: block 0 neuron count in (4..24), all variances 1

b.rule: dA = -alphaA A - 1/2 E[(u_i-g_b)^2], rows projected on simplex sum=1; dW lateral rule alpha=1

c.solver: projected gradient lr .02, 20000 its, random init
c.law: hard constraint |x_i|^2 = nu: q_a = (lambda_a - mu)_+ (this is what is plotted)
c.nonneg_eig: x >= 0 in the eigenbasis of Sigma

fields.a.planted[]: per run: n_block0 (neurons attached to block 0), K_block0 (components made only of block-0 neurons), mean/largest size, K_other_mean, mixed_clusters (components spanning blocks)
fields.a.random[].pts: [component size, prototype variance (eval bank, response variance units), diam_max, diam_mean (eval bank, response units)] per component
fields.a.planted[].diam_*_block0: max / mean over block-0 components of their max / mean member-to-prototype RMS distance (eval bank)
fields.b[].alloc: neurons whose LARGEST block share is block k (argmax; block variances 2, 1, .5, .25)
fields.b[].alloc_majority: neurons with more than half their attachment mass on block k
fields.b[].purity: mean largest block share of a neuron's attachment mass
fields.b[].support: mean number of inputs with a > 1e-6
fields.b[].step_residual: max |dW|,|dA| / dt at the last step (converged iff < res_tol)
fields.c[].q: mode masses q_a = (X^T X)_aa in the eigenbasis
fields.c[].q_pred: water-filling (lambda - mu)_+ with sum = N nu
fields.c[].purity_mean, pure_frac: purity = max_a x_ia^2 / nu; fraction with purity > 0.9
fields.c[].counts, counts_pure: neurons by home mode (argmax), all / only purity > 0.9
fields.c[].n_from_law: q_pred / nu (the neuron-count law if neurons were pure)
fields.c[].n_integer_fill: best integer counts for pure neurons (argmin sum (lambda - n nu)^2)
fields.c[].count_dev: sum |counts - q_pred/nu| / N; count_dev_integer: vs n_integer_fill
fields.c[].obj_main_excess: 1/2||Sigma - X^T X||^2 minus its global minimum under the constraint (>= 0)
fields.c[].grad_map: max |X - P(X - lr grad)| / lr at the end (stationarity)

meta.seed_streams: network attachments [seed,0]; thresholds [seed,3]; training bank [seed,1]; evaluation bank [seed,2]; random covariance presets fixed seed 12345
